ValidationRule.description: Prevent Prod Config from being created as Active.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND ( $Profile.Name <> 'System Administrator', $Profile.Name <> "B - Looker", ISNEW(), ISPICKVAL (Product_Status__c, "Active (Product Live)") )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: You can not create a Prod Config with Status Active. You must create it in another Status and then update it after record creation. Be sure the status date is correct before moving to Active.
